worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.summary: Stand still and send your shadow across the ground to strike the target from behind - no line of sight needed, so it slips around corners. A hit drags the target one step toward the caster. It is the cheapest and fastest first strike in its family. The binding form grabs the target's feet instead, slowing it and pulling it in harder.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.use.0: The cheapest opener, pulling the target in
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.use.1: Stab a target in the back from around a corner
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.use.2: Slow a target with the binding form to set up the next blow
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.descriptio: The shadow blade strikes from behind for about %1$s physical damage; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.

The shadow reaches a target up to %1$s blocks away, crawling along the ground at %2$s blocks/tick and rising as a blade from behind; it travels the floor and needs no line of sight. If the target is gone by then, it catches only air.
A hit drags the target about %1$s blocks toward the caster.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.tether.on: Binding form: a hit binds the target's feet, lowering its Speed by %1$s stage(s) (until switched out or reset) and pulling 60%% harder; the blade is 12%% lighter, the shadow a little shorter and the cooldown longer.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.tether.off: Backstab form: longer, heavier and faster to recover - a pure strike from behind with no slow.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.growth.0: At level %1$s the shadow blade rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.growth.1: At level %1$s the shadow blade rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.shadowsneak.preference: On: the shadow grabs the target's feet, lowering its Speed by one stage and pulling 60% harder, but the blade is 12% lighter, the shadow is 0.6 blocks shorter and the cooldown is 4 ticks longer. Off (backstab): longer, heavier and faster, with no slow.
It reaches for targets within this distance; the shadow reaches much further than a punch, so larger values mean opening from further out.
On: below three tenths health the target is finished with this stab; off: it ranks as an ordinary first-strike candidate.
On: prefer targets whose attention is on someone else (their back to the caster), which reads as a strike from behind; off: ignore facing.
world_combat.move.shadowsneak.text.bind: The shadow bound its feet! Power %1$s
